title: Home loan EMI, flat nahi mila? Supreme Court ka naya order homebuyers ke liye

source.title: Supreme Court of India — Record of Proceedings, W.P.(C) No. 1415/2026, Ravi Kumar Jangra & Anr. v. Union of India & Ors. (CJI Surya Kant, J. Joymalya Bagchi, J. V. Mohana)

hook.caption: Home loan EMI chal rahi, flat bana hi nahi? Supreme Court ka 19 Nov ka order aapko pata hona chahiye.
hook.tts: Home loan की EMI चल रही है, पर flat बना ही नहीं? Supreme Court का उन्नीस November का यह order आपको पता होना चाहिए.

doc.name: SC Order · WP(C) 1415/2026
doc.issuer: Supreme Court of India · CJI Surya Kant bench
doc.caption: Document: Supreme Court ka 3 page ka order. Case: Gurugram ke Sohna mein Raheja Developers ka 'Krishna Housing Scheme' — buyers, SBI aur builder ka tripartite agreement.
doc.tts: Document है Supreme Court का तीन page का order. Gurugram के Sohna में Raheja Developers का Krishna Housing Scheme. Buyers, SBI और builder के बीच tripartite agreement.

points.title: Paisa construction se linked tha
points.quote: Although, the disbursement of the loan was linked to construction progress, the Bank appears to have made payment to the builder without any corresponding progress in the construction.
points.decoded: Loan = construction ke hisaab se. Aarop: bank ne bina progress paisa diya
points.caption: Point 1: Loan construction ke progress ke hisaab se jaana tha. Order kehta hai — bank ne bina construction progress builder ko payment kar diya, aisa lagta hai.
points.tts: पहला point. Loan construction के progress के हिसाब से जाना था. Order कहता है, bank ने बिना construction progress के builder को payment कर दिया, ऐसा लगता है.

points.title: Pehle bank-builder nexus check
points.quote: Unless a categorical finding is returned that the home buyers are in default, no interim direction regarding payment of installments can be issued against them.
points.decoded: Buyer default saabit nahi? Toh EMI ka interim order nahi
points.caption: Point 2: Court ko pehle dekhna hoga ki bank ne tripartite agreement ke hisaab se paisa diya ya nahi. Jab tak buyer clearly default mein na ho, installment ka interim order nahi.
points.tts: दूसरा point. Court को पहले देखना होगा कि bank ने tripartite agreement के हिसाब से पैसा दिया या नहीं. जब तक buyer साफ़ default में न हो, installment का interim order नहीं.

points.title: No coercive action
points.quote: We, therefore, direct the Civil Court to not take any coercive action against the petitioners or similarly placed home buyers without first deciding the above-mentioned issue.
points.decoded: Petitioners + similarly placed buyers: abhi koi zabardasti nahi
points.caption: Point 3: Petitioners aur 'similarly placed' buyers par koi coercive action nahi, jab tak ye sawaal decide na ho. Par yeh ad-interim protection hai — merits par koi opinion nahi.
points.tts: तीसरा point. Petitioners और similarly placed buyers पर कोई coercive action नहीं, जब तक यह सवाल decide न हो. पर यह ad-interim protection है, merits पर कोई opinion नहीं.

lines: Final faisla nahi — lawyer se baat karo
asar.caption: Aap par asar: Noida, Gurugram ya Bengaluru mein flat atka hai aur bank EMI maang raha? Apna tripartite agreement nikalo, aur bank se poocho — paisa construction ke hisaab se gaya tha?
asar.tts: आप पर असर. Noida, Gurugram या Bengaluru में flat अटका है और bank EMI माँग रहा है? अपना tripartite agreement निकालो, और bank से पूछो, पैसा construction के हिसाब से गया था?

seo.title: Home loan EMI Supreme Court order: flat nahi, EMI kyun? #shorts
seo.description:
Home loan EMI Supreme Court — 19 Nov 2026 ka order (W.P.(C) 1415/2026, CJI Surya Kant bench) padh ke:
• Tripartite agreement mein loan construction progress se linked tha
• Court ko pehle builder-bank nexus aur disbursement check karna hoga
• Buyer clearly default mein na ho toh installment ka interim order nahi
• Petitioners + similarly placed homebuyers par no coercive action (ad-interim; merits par opinion nahi)
Yeh legal advice nahi hai.
